metadata.policy: Only official-documentation-backed changes affecting usage economics are listed.

announcements.title: GitHub AI Credits usage-based billing
announcements.summary: Copilot interactions consume token-based AI Credits; 1 AI Credit equals $0.01 USD.
announcements.impact: TokenOps models Copilot credits separately from direct API usage.

announcements.title: GPT-4.1, GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex closing down in Copilot
announcements.summary: GitHub lists these Copilot models as closing down on June 1, 2026.
announcements.impact: They remain available in history but are excluded from default current comparisons.

announcements.title: Promotional AI-credit allowances for existing Business and Enterprise customers
announcements.summary: Existing customers receive higher included AI credits for the first three months of usage-based billing.
announcements.impact: The team estimator can compare promotional and standard pooled allowances.

announcements.title: Agentic sessions and extended context may consume more AI Credits
announcements.summary: GitHub states that long agentic sessions, larger context windows and higher reasoning consume more tokens and credits.
announcements.impact: Agentic presets deliberately use larger editable context assumptions.
